title: MECON Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 17 Draftsman Posts
description: The Metallurgical and Engineering Consultants (MECON) has released an official notification for the recruitment of 17 Draftsman posts. Those candidates who have completed their ITI, Diploma in Civil Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the MECON Notification 2026 .
